newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Russian ambassador suffers fit at Lisbon summit.
newsitem.headline: Russian ambassador suffers fit at Lisbon summit.

text.p: Russia's ambassador to Lisbon Alexander Smirnov was rushed to hospital on Monday after suffering an epileptic fit at a security conference being attended by over 50 countries, security officials said.

They said that the diplomat collapsed during a bilateral meeting between Portuguese Foreign Minister Jaime Gama and his Russian counterpart Yevgeny Primakov on the fringes of the Organisation for Security and Cooperation (OSCE) summit.
A doctor who treated the diplomat before the ambulance arrived told journalists that he did not lose consciousness during the attack and had been taken to hospital as a precaution.
